content.text:
The shared helper is the only place that needs calendar logic. `MemberSummary` passes earnings declarations selected by category label; `FunderSummary` passes all declarations. Preserve both filters.

Change the contract to:

```ts
interface RegistrationMonth {
  start: string; // YYYY-MM-01, UTC
  amount: string | null;
  incomplete: boolean;
}
// registrationTimeline returns { months, undated }
```

`summary.earnings` can keep its current name. Both callers pass `months` into `RegistrationTimeline.svelte`.

Keep these invariants:

- Bucket timestamps by UTC calendar month, including timezone offsets.
- Normalize to midnight on the first day before advancing with `setUTCMonth`.
- Sum decimal strings with the existing BigInt arithmetic.
- Fill intervening months with `"0"` and `incomplete: false`.
- Retain `null` for a month containing only unavailable amounts.
- Include known GBP values even when that month also has unavailable values.
- Foreign currency entries neither create buckets nor extend the chart.
- Eligible undated entries set `undated` without adding a bucket.

Cheap monthly tests should cover January 31 to February 1, leap-year February through March, December through January, an offset timestamp crossing a UTC month boundary, and a skipped month. Retain existing precision, negative, zero, unknown-currency, and earnings classification assertions.

The existing January weekly fixtures will merge into one January bar. Move an unavailable-only declaration to a later month if the test should continue proving both zero-gap and null-month behavior.

Update headings, SVG titles/descriptions, tooltip prefixes, and partial notes. `entity-details.spec.ts` currently asserts “Weekly registered earnings” twice and “Weekly registered funding” once; change these to monthly and assert at least one monthly tooltip amount.
